subject: Re: Data lifecycle evidence request and scoped retention playbook
messages:
From: James Liao <compliance@acmetech.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@acmetech.com
Date: 2027-12-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Data lifecycle evidence request — scoped items for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement security review we need a compact bundle of artifacts focused on data retention and deletion controls for the Redwood hosted inference service. To keep this scoped we are primarily interested in: 1) a retention matrix that maps data types (logs, KV cache, model inputs, user uploads, embeddings) to retention periods and retention enforcement mechanism; 2) evidence of secure deletion / proof-of-delete for at least one sample tenant; 3) CAIQ/SIG answers that reference retention/deletion controls; and 4) documentation of any customer-specific retention carveouts (legal holds, extended forensics).

If possible, could you provide the items below by end-of-week (Fri 12/17)? We realize some items may be links rather than attachments — that is fine. Items: 
- retention matrix (CSV or spreadsheet)
- sample proof-of-delete (timestamped runbook or audit log excerpt)
- CAIQ/SIG retention-related sections (PDF or link)
- any playbook describing how you handle customer-specific exceptions and escalation path to Legal/Trust

Also include any diagrams that explain ephemeral caches (KV cache/ prefix caching) TTLs and deletion behavior. If there are items that require an internal approval or that you can only provide under an NDA, flag them.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to set a 30-min workshop if it helps.

Best,
James Liao
Senior Compliance Manager
AcmeTech

[attachment: acmetech-questionnaire-2027.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Liao <compliance@acmetech.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-12T10:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Data lifecycle evidence request — scoped items for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ

James — thanks for the clear list. We'll compile a focused pack that addresses the items you listed. Quick plan and owners: 

- Retention matrix (CSV): Olga will produce a tenant-scoped matrix and include system defaults vs. customer overrides. (owner: olga_petrov)
- Proof-of-delete: Marissa will pull a redwood-managed sample proof-of-delete (audit log + artifact) for a demo tenant. We will sanitize identifiers. (owner: marissa_cole)
- CAIQ/SIG retention snippets: Karthik will extract the relevant CAIQ sections and highlight our controls. (owner: karthik_iyer)
- Playbook for exceptions/legal holds: I'll draft a one-page playbook describing the escalation flow, decision points, and SLAs for holds. (owner: nikhil_sharma)

Attachments vs links: we'll prepare a ZIP with the artefacts and also share a Drive folder. If you need a signed NDA to receive any redacted screenshots, flag that — otherwise everything we plan to share is non-sensitive.

Deliverable ETA: we can get the first tranche (matrix + CAIQ snippets + TTL diagram) by EOD 12/14; proof-of-delete may follow 12/15 depending on custodial approvals. If that timeline is tight for you, we can book a 30-min sync on 12/15.

Thanks — Nikhil
Head of Trust / Product Security (acting)
Redwood Inference

[signature block]

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-14T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Data lifecycle evidence request — scoped items for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ

Nikhil / team — draft artefacts attached / linked below. Per the plan, I focused the retention matrix on the following categories: inference-inputs, model-outputs, embeddings, ephemeral KV cache, application logs, audit logs, and customer uploads. Notes in the CSV clarify default TTLs, index of where TTL is enforced (service vs. object store), and whether deletion is logical vs. physical.

Quick summary of attached items: 
- redwood-retention-matrix-2027.csv (attached) — columns: data_type, default_ttl_days, enforcement_location, deletion_mechanism, periodic_job_name, retention_override_supported, notes
- kvcache-ttl-diagram.png (attached) — flow diagram showing cache eviction, prefix cache invalidation, and KV cache zeroization on tenant termination
- soc2-evidence-bundle-2027-12-14.zip (attached, contains sanitized audit excerpts and runbook) 
- caiq-answers-2027-12-14.pdf (Drive link included)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example (folder contains the same artifacts and an index.md that maps items to SOC2 criteria).

One item to flag: the sample proof-of-delete includes audit log excerpts that reference internal audit IDs. Legal asked we redact tenant IDs before sharing externally; Marissa can produce a redacted PDF. I put the unredacted export in an internal location and will not send externally until Legal signs off.

If you're good with the drafts, I'll prepare the redacted proof-of-delete and assemble the ZIP we send to Acme by EOD 12/14.

—Olga
Senior Trust Engineer
Redwood Inference

[attachments: redwood-retention-matrix-2027.csv; kvcache-ttl-diagram.png; soc2-evidence-bundle-2027-12-14.zip]

From: James Liao <compliance@acmetech.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@acmetech.com
Date: 2027-12-14T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Data lifecycle evidence request — scoped items for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ

Nikhil / Olga — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the folder link. A couple quick follow-ups from our side after a preliminary review: 

1) The retention matrix looks good; please include one additional column indicating whether data is encrypted-at-rest and which KMS (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed) controls the key.
2) For proof-of-delete — redaction is fine, but we will need a time-bound chain of custody demonstrating that deletion was executed (audit trail + job invocation id + storage object summary). A redacted PDF with those fields preserved is acceptable.
3) For CAIQ: please highlight any answers where you rely on contract (e.g., customer-managed retention settings) vs. platform defaults.

We'd also like a short (30-min) working session to walk through the KV cache eviction diagram and the proof-of-delete workflow; are you available on 12/16 at 9am PT? If not, propose two slots.

If you can add the encryption/KMS column and confirm the 12/16 slot, we can call this ready for our downstream SIG assessor.

Best regards,
James Liao
Senior Compliance Manager
AcmeTech
